picks.thesis: Re-issue of the 11:20 same-day call, which never filled: SQQQ ran to $37.92 before the bot ran, above the $37.60 cap set off a 25-minute-old snapshot. Wrong if QQQ gets back above today's open (~$725.5); stop 4.5%.
